answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake before taking paid work, with reputation growing only through completed jobs attested by established peers. Like yarrow spreading one rooted stem at a time, trust accrues slowly per identity and cannot be copied across clones. A sybil farm must stake and fund each fake separately, while a bridge of cross-checks between independent verifiers catches clusters vouching for each other. Colluding attestors lose their stake in a plume of slashed bonds, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds.
